notes.text: Case a writes K^\sigma=K, identifies the resulting real points with M_{0,\unsure{5|\bar I}}^{!}\simeq Sym_2^*(U_{0,3}), and gives real dimension 2 and case 1° (pentagonal). The intended five-point setting does not resolve the tiny subscript ink.

Case b writes Card K^\sigma=3, followed by a comma, and chooses un repère 0,1,infinity dans K^\sigma. It writes K={0,1,infinity,lambda,bar lambda}, with lambda in the Poincaré half-plane, real dimension 2, and case 3° (bitétraédral).

Case c writes Card K^\sigma=1 and K^\sigma={P}; its interlinear insertion reads \unsure{Soit} K\setminus K^\sigma=I, donc. The canceled construction begins capital On, has an uncertain central phrase and a t_0/infinity candidate, continues with numeric 0=sigma 0, and ends in uncertain OP/sigma P. The two canceled clauses remain one continuous deletion owner.

The paragraph says that the four-point system on a complex sphere admits an involutive antiautomorphisme/anti-isomorphisme, called conjugaison, has real modular dimension 1, and gains one real dimension on adding P, for total dimension 2. It refers to the square-pyramidal case 2°. The first long-word reading is favored but its compressed middle remains doubtful.
The lower chart places the dimensions 2,1,0 over its three graphs and gives component counts 1,10,15 beneath them.

The first chart column gives 12 realizations. The two overlapping label baselines retain doubtful live modulaires/spéciales and canceled polyédriques; multiplicités/multiples is recorded as an unresolved reading of the combined cluster, not an added word.
The manuscript writes 10×3×2=60.
The manuscript writes 10×2×6=120.
The manuscript writes 15×2×2=60.
The manuscript’s final factors read 5×3×2=30. The last 2 is marked with a doubt concerning a possible earlier 1 or 4 underneath; the final numeral and the existing arithmetic check are unchanged.
The manuscript writes 10×2=20.
The face is manuscript on perforated tractor-feed paper. No coherent front-side typescript or reversed printed text was found to transcribe; sheet_kind is text.
Only muni d’ is crossed out. There is one live un to its right; C’s additional cancelled un is unsupported by the visible ink.

Root checked the fixed factor detail and complete existing chart. The upper curve and broad foot secure final 2; a separate thin upright may be an earlier 1 or 4, or part of the retraced 2. All three source-state alternatives remain explicit.

The third graph retains its upright free branch, separate canceled diagonal, vertex and baseline gap. Two angular crossing turns and a lower returning cancellation loop replace the old zigzag. The chart arrows retain upper open heads, the right lower hook, and a separate lower downward/rightward head. The inner upper and lower segments have an actual blank interval between them.

The bottom sketch retains the first geometry and physical size, including its interrupted left side and upper outer-loop head. The central open rounded glyph remains sigma/0, with sigma favored; no topological meaning has been assigned.

The full bowl with returning ends after the first 60 favors c; its case remains c/C. The canceled upper caption remains doubtful. The lower replacement is inserted (polyèdres/tétraèdres-pointés), with polyèdres favored and no second e in pointés.
The top 3 is retained as author pagination. The separate, lighter bottom-left 35 is retained as foliation in another unnamed hand.
No written date appears on this sheet. No date has been inferred from the paper or arithmetic.
H’s editorial page note and prose drawing synopses are not manuscript prose. The actual drawings are reproduced in TikZ.

Two additional dedicated crops cover the rising first paragraph line and the modulaire line. Earlier adjoining crops contained only contextual fragments of those lines; no decided place was recropped.

Conditional on sigma acting as an involution on the five-element set K, its orbits have sizes1 or2. Thus the fixed-point count is odd and can only be1,3 or5, agreeing with the three cases inherited from the preceding page. This finite-set observation does not prove the asserted moduli identifications or component counts.

Root personally viewed all 29 differing fixed crops and the complete pre-existing chart, using its JPEG proxy after the PNG display was truncated. Only root’s supplied decisions were implemented. The chart remains one .009cm-coordinate figure: the two cancellation paths are translated by (760,1645), at .6pt and .35pt, and the seven arrow-only paths by (525,1695), with their supplied widths. Context words, graph fragments, bounding boxes and clips are excluded.
